finalWarning.title: A letter in a plain envelope
finalWarning.body: Someone from People and Culture sits you down in the room with the tissues. You are now on a Final Warning. It has been explained that this is a supportive process, and that it ends with you being supported out of the building if there is another incident.

fired.title: You have been released to the wider market
fired.body: You were on a Final Warning, and there has been another incident. Your pass stops working between the lift and your desk. A colleague you have never met carries your plant to the loading bay, and asks you to sign for it.

firedOutright.title: You have been released to the wider market, today
firedOutright.body: Nobody needs a second incident. By the time you reach your desk there is a box on it, and someone from Security is holding the lid. An all-staff email thanks you for your contribution, and spells your name wrong.

results.title: Your employment has concluded
results.intro: You did not reach the end of your review period. A form says that you left to pursue other opportunities. Here is what the form leaves out.

finished: You lasted the whole review period, and nobody has fired you yet.
